releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.12.1 improves Files > Search for large libraries and photo viewing. The old 25-result cap is removed: All, Documents, Photos/Images and Videos now expose every matching indexed result in 15-item pages with Previous and Next controls. Changing the filter, filename query or reloading the file index returns to page 1, while multi-select can continue across pages. Tapping a photo outside selection mode now opens it directly inside Smart Life with pinch-to-zoom instead of Android Open with. Search result photo/video thumbnails and document previews are slightly larger, while live filter counts, Category exclusion, multi-select, Add to Category and permanent Delete remain unchanged.
